definitions.explanation: Approaching or involving something from multiple perspectives or directions. Used in both analytical and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {多角的|たかくてき}に{分析|ぶんせき}する。
{問題|もんだい}を{多角的|たかくてき}に{検討|けんとう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to examine the issue from multiple perspectives.

examples.japanese: この{企業|きぎょう}は{多角的|たかくてき}な{事業|じぎょう}{展開|てんかい}で{成長|せいちょう}してきた。
examples.english: This company has grown through diversified business development.

notes: Formed from {多角|たかく} (many angles/sides) and {的|てき} (adjectival suffix). In business, {多角的|たかくてき}な{経営|けいえい} means diversified management. In academic or analytical contexts, it means examining something from multiple viewpoints. Collocations: {多角的|たかくてき}に{分析|ぶんせき}する (analyze from multiple angles), {多角的|たかくてき}な{視点|してん} (multifaceted perspective), {多角的|たかくてき}{経営|けいえい} (diversified management).
